title: fix(components): the docs flow embed names the flow and its approval steps in the reader's language

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：非英文读者打开带流程嵌入的使用手册时，流程标题、审批步骤名，以及判断分支指向的审批步骤名，改用读者语言显示（例如「大额商机审批」「销售经理审核」）；包里没有译文的地方仍显示原文。
- 为什么做：HotCRM 中文手册里的审批流程图标题和步骤全是英文，而包里已带中文译文；这是此前 Studio 流程设计器同类修复未覆盖的文档查看器。
- 出错会怎样：只影响显示，最坏情况是某个步骤仍显示原文；不改任何数据，可直接撤回。开始、判断、通知、结束这几类步骤的译文位置已裁定要补，由另一项单独完成，本次仍显示原文。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

- **The docs viewer's flow embed reads the package's flow labels.** `FlowView` in `element:metadata_viewer` now draws the flow title from `flows.FLOW.label` and each `approval` step from `flows.FLOW.approvals.NODE_ID.label`, in the reader's language, and falls back to the authored label (then the name / node id) where the bundle has no entry. Two label reads changed (`flow.label`, `n.label`), through one hook call placed before the early returns.
- **Branch targets too.** Since #36327 landed, the business view lists each decision's branches and names the step each branch leads to. That name now takes the same translated step label (a `stepLabel` prop on `Branches`), so an approval step reached from a decision is not named in English beside its translated row.
- **The flow-label resolution moved to `@object-ui/i18n`.** `ui/packages/i18n/src/flowLabels.ts` holds `flowLabelTranslations` and `useFlowLabelTranslations`, moved from the Studio module because `@object-ui/components` cannot import `@object-ui/app-shell`. It is built on `activeFlowsBundle`, which #36316 already moved into `@object-ui/i18n` (`flowsBundle.ts`); this PR adds no second copy of that reader. The flow label still goes through the spec's `translateFlow`; the step label is still read for `approval` nodes only. The Studio module keeps its own parts (the Automations rail reader and the canvas context) and re-exports the moved ones, so its call sites are unchanged.
- **Which steps can be translated today.** The spec's `flows.FLOW` group has a label key only for `approval` steps. A start, decision, notify or end step keeps its authored label until the Asked item 2 work adds its key.
- No spec change, no server change. `GET /meta/flow` is unchanged; the embed reads the bundle the host already loads.

## Read first (by risk)

1. `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/basic/metadata-viewer.tsx`, the `FlowView` and `Branches` hunks: the hook sits before the early returns, beside the `business` flag from #36327.
2. `ui/packages/i18n/src/flowLabels.ts`: the moved resolver; compare with the Studio original removed from `flow-label-translations.tsx`.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/flow-label-translations.tsx`: what stays in Studio, and the re-export.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/components/src/__tests__/metadata-viewer.test.tsx`; expect 18 passed, including the three tests under "flow embed: package label translations".

## Tests

<details><summary>Pins (one top-level describe in the existing viewer harness)</summary>

`metadata-viewer.test.tsx`, describe "element:metadata_viewer flow embed: package label translations (flows.FLOW.label, approvals.STEP.label)", with a real `createI18n` instance loaded from a zh-CN `TranslationData` through `transformSpecTranslations`, inside `I18nProvider`:

- an `opportunity_approval`-shaped flow draws 大额商机审批, 销售经理审核 and 销售总监签批, and none of the English approval labels; the start, decision, notify and end steps keep their authored labels;
- a bundle entry without the flow label and without one step falls back to the authored text; a bundle that translates only another flow leaves everything authored;
- a decision branch whose target is an approval step names it 销售总监签批, and the English label appears nowhere on the card.

The Studio pins in `FlowCanvas.test.tsx` exercise the moved resolver unchanged.
</details>

<details><summary>Runs</summary>

- At 78faa00e0a, under the verify lock: `vitest run` of `metadata-viewer.test.tsx` and `FlowCanvas.test.tsx`: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 47 passed (47)`; then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components run type-check` (both tsc programs); `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- At 10f53529e4 (first main merge), under the lock: turbo build of the `@object-ui/app-shell^...` and `@object-ui/components^...` closures (68 tasks successful), the same two files (`Tests 40 passed (40)`), and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n --filter @object-ui/components --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check`: test exit 0, type-check exit 0.
- Ablation at 78faa00e0a through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete`: anchor `(target && stepLabel?.(target)) ?? ` 1 to 0, blob e0610844af58 to 1bcbe5a1bdbb. Result: `Tests 1 failed | 17 passed (18)`, the branch-target pin red. Restored: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty. A first attempt with `--replacement ''` was refused by the tool before any test ran (it cannot count an empty replacement), so it measured nothing. The test resolves the viewer through `src`, so no dist preflight applies.
- Earlier ablation of the two label reads (seat 4, at 1ffd047104): both original pins red, restored clean.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Merges.** This branch merged `origin/main` twice. First merge (c261a7ca60, #36316, already on main): #36316 moved `activeFlowsBundle` into `@object-ui/i18n` at the same path this branch had used. Resolution kept main's `flowsBundle.ts` byte-for-byte, dropped this branch's duplicate move, and kept `flowLabels.ts` and its export. `git grep` on the merged tree: one `function activeFlowsBundle` (`ui/packages/i18n/src/flowsBundle.ts`), no app-shell copy, no `utils/flowsBundle` import left. Second merge (e6057734a2, #36327): kept its branches and entry-condition code and its tests, and added the two label reads plus the branch-target label.
- **Measurement for Asked item 2 (built elsewhere).** hotcrm `opportunity_approval` (hotcrm 01d3ec4): 13 nodes; 11 drawn at the default business altitude; 2 have a key (`approval`), 9 do not: 1 start, 3 decision, 4 notify, 1 end.
- The embed's subtitle is the authored `flow.description`. The spec's `flows` group has no description key, so it stays authored.
- No `content/docs` page documents the viewer (only its ADR, a governed surface), so no docs page changed.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/components` and `@object-ui/i18n` patch. `@object-ui/app-shell` is private and its behaviour is unchanged.
